gold_value_mask_overlap.matching_method: Case-insensitive exact substring; ISO dates and common written date forms, and limited leading-article location variants. This does not adjudicate selection rationale.

limitations: Gold answer string overlap is a mechanical check, not a human determination of whether the masked span was necessary evidence or selection rationale.
The 24-example report uses the original instruction condition; it does not establish transfer to the task-constraint-removed prompts.
